entities.name: Nelly Neppach
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nelly Neppach was a German female tennis player. Neppach was the first German female to establish an international reputation. Some weeks after Hitler had become Reichskanzler, she was forced out of the sport by the Nazi regime. She committed suicide at age 34.
